changes: Without PUID and PGID the container now keeps the current owner of its data and backups folders instead of switching them to 1000. Only root-owned or new folders fall back to 1000.

Unraid: the install command now saves the template under the name Unraid uses itself. The old file name could make updates drop variables added later, such as PUID and PGID. If you installed before this version, see the README for a one-line fix.

Automatic backups, by default once a day: set the interval in days, how many to always keep, and after how many days older ones are deleted. Manual, uploaded and safety backups are never deleted automatically.

Backups can now be restored, uploaded and deleted in Settings. Restoring checks the backup, saves the current state as a safety backup first, also accepts backups from older versions, and then asks you to sign in again.
Backups now stay consistent even if something is being saved at that moment, and also work with a custom database path.
The container no longer runs as root. It uses PUID and PGID (default 1000, Unraid template 99/100) and takes over its data and backups folders on start.
Updated to Node.js 24 LTS, and the container now reports its health and stops immediately on updates.
A test suite now runs before every image is built.
Fixed messages on the login and account pages that showed a technical key such as account.saved instead of text.
Page titles and new dashboard groups now follow the selected language.
Pinned snippets keep the order you dragged them into, and otherwise follow the sorting from Settings.
The X on a dashboard group member now returns to the dashboard instead of showing raw data.
Unpinning a bookmark removes it from its dashboard group, and groups disappear once their last bookmark is gone.
Fixed the category list after switching boards: the delete prompt shows the right name, and names with quotes display correctly.
Names with special characters now display correctly in delete prompts.
Unknown or invalid addresses now show the "not found" page instead of an error.
Snippets can now be up to 2 MB instead of 100 KB.
Forms can no longer be submitted from other websites, and session cookies are no longer sent along with cross-site requests.
Error pages no longer reveal technical details. Docker images now run in production mode.
Bookmark addresses must start with http:// or https://, also for icons.
Login is locked for 15 minutes after 10 failed attempts, and every login starts with a fresh session.
The session secret is now optional: if none is set, or only the example value, one is generated and stored in the data folder. Installations still using the example value are logged out once.
Custom greeting texts are now shown as plain text, HTML in them is no longer interpreted.
Updated dependencies with known security issues.
First tagged release of BookmarkRanger, a self-hosted manager for bookmarks and code snippets.
Bookmarks: boards and categories that switch without a page reload, drag-and-drop and up/down reordering with custom sorting, and one dialog for renaming, deleting and reordering.
Snippets: tags, search, sorting by created/updated/name, syntax highlighting, and copying the code or a raw-text URL.
Dashboard: pinned categories, links and snippets, groups for pinned links, and an optional greeting with date, time and current weather (via Open-Meteo, no API key required).
Sharing: publish boards, categories and snippets to any number of named public pages, each with its own URL and no login required to view.
Favicons are looked up from each site's own declared icon and hotlinked from that site instead of being stored locally.
Settings: 16 color themes plus custom themes, German and English per account, on-demand database backups, and this changelog.
Docker image published via GitHub Actions, docker-compose file and Unraid template.
